chapter_seo_title: Chapter 88 of Dao Gui Yi Xian — Li Huowang enters a suspicious village with ancient rules.
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang emerges from a lethal bamboo grove into a seemingly normal village. But the village head’s ancient rules suggest Layue Shiba may already be watching.
og_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 88 — Rules
og_description: A bamboo grove that feels like a throat. A village that looks too normal. And an old man with rules that cannot be broken. Li Huowang suspects the trap has already sprung.
twitter_description: Li Huowang emerges from a deadly bamboo maze into a peaceful village. Too peaceful. The village head has rules. Layue Shiba might already be here.
